titre: Design systems enter the age of agents, and governance becomes the real topic

syntheses.texte: Tokens, design.md files and MCP servers bridge the system and the agents. Documentation is no longer written only for humans: it becomes the interface AI reads to produce consistent screens.

Complete design systems are being built with Claude and VS Code, with living documentation and a “Try it” sandbox. Prototyping moves closer to production code, and Figma is no longer the only starting point.
Giving agents write access is worthless without someone deciding what should not become a component. The real work is still the decision and its documentation, not producing the artifact.
